credits.title: Rewind Barcelona
credits.overview: Hascoët, Émile, Léo, and Paul are a rowdy group of teenage skateboarders. They pile into Léo’s mom’s car and drive to Barcelona, the mecca of skateboarding, for their first trip away as almost-adults. credits.title: What She Do
credits.overview: In May 2021, an assault reawakened my childhood memories. I decided to go to the United States to find my mother, after 10 years of silence. credits.title: No Skate!
credits.overview: The 2024 Paris Olympic Games. Isaac is a sandwich-board man. Cléo is a sandwich-board woman. One day, Isaac sees Cléo throw a skateboard into the water.

credits.title: Beau comme un tracteur
credits.overview: A young city girl explores the idea of beauty with her uncle Michel, a retired farmer from the Beauce region. An amusing and touching encounter between two visions of art and the world.

credits.title: Santa Maria Kyoko
credits.overview: In the village of Santa Maria Poggio, in Haute-Corse, far from their native Japan, Kyoko and Yutaro, two lovers, are at a loss. They decide to spend the day apart.

credits.title: Wild Fruits
credits.overview: 16th century: After a period overseas in the Antarctic France, Jean Aurand finds refuge as a servant in the house of French philosopher Michel de Montaigne, where a series of fantastical events change the lives of these two men forever.

credits.title: Chronicles of my crew
credits.overview: Antoine, 14, skateboards through the streets of Bordeaux with his friends and his little camera. Paul, 25, spends a night in the city with his friends, rewinding the movie.

credits.title: Insieme Insieme
credits.overview: An unusual bandit trio spends autumn in a village by Lake Maggiore. In their holiday apartment they create a parallel world, which little reflects their surroundings. As the pressures of the outside world begin to weigh in on them, they kidnap a tourist in order to give their lives a purpose.

credits.title: Perce-oreille
credits.overview: Violette struggles to find her first summer job. She finally finds a place, a place where one makes holes.

credits.title: The Struggle Against Myself
credits.overview: Bordeaux, 1955. City Mayor Jacques Chaban-Delmas dreams of the district of the year 2000.

credits.title: Camille, Contactless
credits.overview: Paris in summer. Maxime has a revelation: Camille, the pretty cashier at the supermarket no longer interests him. The problem is, he does not know how to tell her without hurting her. The other problem is that in fact he has never dared to speak to her.

credits.title: The Remains
credits.overview: Alfonse returns to the family château after a long absence. His brother Samuel takes a dim view of this return.

credits.title: Presque au bout du monde
credits.overview: 2029. The Baudrier family, the heads of a pharmaceutical empire, are preparing to flee to Patagonia, a land that has been spared. Aimé Baudrier, the heir son, opposes the departure, while in the night a mysterious commando approaches.

credits.title: The Jellyfish of Gouville
credits.overview: Antoine’s dreamy gaze slowly shifts from the jellyfish he’s fascinated by to Jeanne, his brother’s girlfriend, who’s come to stay with them in Gouville for the holidays.
